summary: Nothing is broken and no hard rule is breached. Rising is the one project short of working. Its last open action closed in 5a916cf on the day it was found. Everything fixed two of its three mediums in 6ea707e2 a day after its review, and this pass closes them in the status file. Gnosis now carries seven of the portfolio's eight open actions, with security-02 unresolved since 2026-10-17. The four oldest queue rows, 53 to 60 days old, all wait on a hand action.
